title: Quotation from a call write-up
summary: A quotation for the customer of an earlier call write-up or proposal, left as a draft for you to approve.
text: Draft a quotation for the customer in [earlier], for what they asked for there. Take every price from our price list and invent nothing; if a price is missing, say so instead of guessing. Leave it as a draft for me to approve; do not send it to anyone. Then write a short read-back of what the quotation says, so I can check it before I approve it.
